name: 朝の駅のホーム
description: A morning train station platform. A woman is sitting on a bench in the center, and a man is looking at his smartphone on the left. On the right, a boy is sitting on a seat while a man carries a box in front. A boy is running toward the back, and a bag is next to the bench.
